definition: Orange is an open-source data visualization, machine learning and data mining toolkit.
details: It features a visual programming front-end for exploratory qualitative data analysis and interactive data visualization.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Better ingredients make a better meal, and the same is true here. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. And that is Orange (software) — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
